name: Dropcontact
summary: Find and verify professional emails and add company data to contact lists, asynchronously, paying only for verified emails.

api_key.description: A Dropcontact API key (Dropcontact app > API). Sent raw in X-Access-Token.

notes: Enrichment is asynchronous: submit with enrich.batch, then poll enrich.results by request_id.
Pay on success: one credit per verified email found; credits_left is in batch and result responses.
The default-webhook endpoints (set, get, delete) are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Get credit balance
endpoints.summary: Credits left on the account, free credits included.

endpoints.name: Enrich a batch of contacts
endpoints.summary: Submit up to 250 contacts to find and verify emails and add company data. Returns a request_id to poll.

data.description: Up to 250 records, each at most 15 kB. Fields: first_name, last_name, full_name, email, linkedin, job, company, website, country, num_siren, siret, custom_fields and more. A record needs a company identifier, an email or a LinkedIn URL.

siren.description: Add the company SIREN and SIRET to results. Default false.

language.description: Language of the email qualification label, fr or en. Default fr.

hashedInputs.description: Add a hashedInputs field to the response. Default false.

notes: Starts a billed job: it only produces data and changes nothing else in your account.
Starts a job that only produces data: it returns request_id, and the enriched records come from dropcontact.enrich.results.

One credit per record only when a verified email is returned, deducted at submit and refunded if none is found. A record that carries an "email" field (verification only) costs one credit and is not refunded.
If credits do not cover every record, the whole request is refused with 403.

endpoints.name: Fetch enrichment results
endpoints.summary: Enriched records for a request_id, in input order.

request_id.description: Id returned by the batch call.

forceResults.description: Return records already enriched instead of waiting for the whole batch; adds a status of ready or in_progress.

notes: Poll until success is true: while the batch is incomplete the answer is 200 with success false.
